variantes.enunciado: I have a headache. Complete the advice: You ___ play video games all day.
pistas: Si haces «play video games all day», ¿te vas a sentir mejor o peor?
Si ayuda → should. Si empeora → shouldn't.
«I have a cold. You ___ wear a warm jacket» → should (te ayuda a no enfriarte).
variantes.solucion: I have a headache. You shouldn't play video games all day.
